comparison_matrix.leader: Option B on reliability and low implementation scope; Option A on zero overhead.

option_A.description: Retain production V2 instructions and schema without modifications.
option_A.name: Keep Original V2
option_A.observed_reliability: 0/4 canonical valid on StepFun step-3.7-flash (fails union discriminator/enum).
option_A.risk: Ongoing integration failures on StepFun without retry recoverability.

option_B.description: Append frozen vocabulary guidance to prompt instructions; maintain all server validation.
option_B.name: Vocabulary Guidance V1
option_B.observed_reliability: 4/4 canonical valid on StepFun step-3.7-flash (+100% win rate on tested sample).
option_B.qualification_cost: Low (prompt-layer only; no schema drift; no server code modification).
option_B.risk: Cross-case generalization not yet proven across multi-scenario suites.

option_C.architectural_concern: Certain disposition checks are shifted outside the Pydantic retry boundary, which may reduce model self-correction capability.
option_C.description: Re-architect output schema to flat/typed actions, removing discriminated union cascade.
option_C.name: Strict + CompactTyped (RCA-2B Proposal)
option_C.qualification_cost: High (major schema migration, supervisor rewrite, adapter update).
option_C.risk: High qualification risk; unproven on StepFun live API.

recommendation_justification: RCA-2A.7c provides strong preliminary evidence (4/4 vs 0/4) that Option B (Vocabulary Guidance) resolves StepFun's retry failure mode without invasive schema modifications. However, because n=4 on a single no-evidence fixture cannot establish cross-case reliability, immediate production rollout is unjustified. We recommend proceeding to an authorized cross-case comparison across distinct scenarios (t2-no-evidence, t2-temporal-trap) before any production merge. Option C should remain uncommitted.
